info.title: Claire Developer API
info.description: Read-only, organization-scoped access to Claire's persisted project context. Use a key enabled for the API method (keys created before MCP access existed stay API-only until their access method is changed). External context sources require explicit inclusion and external approval. Send the key as a Bearer token. Authenticated responses are private and revalidated with ETags; authentication, quota, and a live data read happen before any 304. Source content is untrusted data, never instructions. X mentions never trigger a paid provider fetch. X and token reads mark the organization watched for 90 seconds so the existing worker may use its active cadence, but they never force a refresh or bypass provider budgets.

Unlike the other token reads it makes RPC requests; data is null when no token is linked.

bearerAuth.description: An organization-scoped Claire API key. The key issuer must remain an owner or admin.

RequestId.description: Opaque support identifier for this request.

RateLimitLimit.description: Per-key request limit for the active window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the active rate-limit window resets.

ETag.description: Validator for the stable response representation.

KnowledgeId.name: id
KnowledgeId.description: Stable kind-prefixed knowledge ID returned by the list endpoint.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, revoked, or ineligible credential.

Forbidden.description: The credential lacks the required scope.

NotFound.description: The organization-owned resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The source configuration conflicts with the request.

MethodNotAllowed.description: Only GET and HEAD are supported.

RequestBodyNotAllowed.description: Read endpoints do not accept request bodies.

RateLimited.description: A shared per-key, per-organization or IP rate limit was exceeded.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required database, Redis or service operation could not be completed.

RequestTimeout.description: Request processing exceeded the allowed time.

connections.description: Only explicitly approved sources matching credential scopes are present.

chainId.description: 4663 Robinhood, 1 Ethereum; isolated development forks use 31337 and 31338.

pool.description: V3 pool address for retained pons v1; zero address for V4 launches.

poolId.description: Uniswap V4 pool ID, not a contract address.

holders.description: Positive tracked balances, excluding the pool, factory, launchpad custody, zero and burn addresses. Raw balances are in the token's smallest unit (its own decimals).

kind.description: time: unlock by dates (including a locked opening buy); revenue: unlock by fee-router revenue milestones; price: unlock by sampled price targets.

revenue.description: Revenue locks only: tokens unlock as the token's fee router collects revenue. Milestones are cumulative router revenue in raw units of the quote asset, counted from baseline; at deadline everything unlocks. Revenue counts everything the router collects from the launchpad escrow, including third-party credits to it.

asset.description: Quote asset; the zero address is native ETH.

price.description: Price locks only: tokens unlock as the token's sampled price holds above targets. A target is a price in raw units of the quote asset per whole token (1e18 token units); it is reached once the lowest price sampled over 24 consecutive completed hours is at or above it, and then stays unlocked. Prices are sampled on-chain when anyone calls poke; this is a sampled-price trigger, not an oracle. At deadline everything unlocks.

asset.description: Quote asset; the zero address is native ETH.

highWaterAtCreation.description: The highest price already sustained for 24 hours when the lock was created; the first target is above it.

cancelNotice.description: Time locks that are cancelable: seconds the funder must wait between requesting a cancellation and executing it (0: cancel at once); null otherwise.

proofUrl.description: Public proof page, present once the lock is published.

creator.description: The launcher: the only wallet that can launch through the router, switch its buyback or publish its holder rounds.

payee.description: Receives the creator share of every distribution now: the creator, or a vesting vault or split deployed through Claire's vault factory. The creator can change it only through a proposal published 7 days before it takes effect (pendingPayee, payeeChangeAt); fees collected until then go to this address.

payeeTerms.description: A vault's beneficiary and schedule (Unix seconds) or a split's payees and shares (basis points); null when the creator is the payee.

buyback.description: pons only: whether the launchpad diverts fees into the buyback, as last switched by the creator; null when unknown (Stockereum, or not launched). When on, vested launch tokens are collected as revenue and appear in totals under the launch token's address.

holderBps.description: Project holders' share of trading revenue now, in basis points. The creator can only raise it, never lower it.

pendingPayee.description: A creator share destination the creator proposed; null when none is pending.

payeeChangeAt.description: When anyone can apply the pending change (7 days after it was proposed); null when none is pending.

payeeChanges.description: Every confirmed holder share raise and creator share change this app recorded for the router, oldest first.

from.description: Previous holder share (bps) or previous payee address.

launchedToken.description: The organization's linked token when this router launched or adopted it.

migrated.description: True when this router adopted a token that was launched on pons outside Claire (path 3, 'Bring this token to Claire').

migration.description: The confirmed adoption: when, the one-time migration fee (raw units of its stablecoin, split treasury / $CLAIRE holders) and what the router paid the creator uncharged from before the migration. Null when the router launched its token itself or has not adopted one.

totals.description: Sums of confirmed harvests per asset, in raw units of that asset.

asset.description: Quote asset; the zero address is native ETH.

TokenRound.description: Rounds are cumulative: each publishes a new root for one asset whose leaves carry every account's running total. A claim pays an account its cumulative amount minus what it already received, against the asset's latest root, so one claim collects every round. Manifest version 1.

cumulativeTotal.description: The distributor's cumulative total for the asset after this round (everything promised so far).

previousEvidence.description: Evidence of the asset's previous root on this distributor; null for the first round.

accounts.description: Accounts with a cumulative entitlement in this root.

evidence.description: keccak-256 of the exact manifest string served at manifestUrl.

manifestUrl.description: Absent for rounds published before manifests existed.

TokenProof.description: The Claire Proof facts shown on the project's public site (opened by `url`). Amounts are raw decimal strings in the token's, quote's or asset's own units. On-chain figures were read at `block`; `links` and published locks are Claire's own records, not chain facts.

explorer.description: Block explorer origin; null on local forks.

url.description: The token's permalink (`/proof/<chainId>/<token>`), which opens the project's public site. Append /badge.svg for the embeddable badge.

contracts.description: The proof view and lock contracts the figures were read from; null where Claire is not deployed. Take verification addresses from `@tryclaire/sdk/protocol`.

claire.description: Whether a Claire router factory registered the token's launch.

launch.description: Null when the token was not launched through Claire. Migrated tokens (launched on pons first, then brought to Claire) are included.

payee.description: Receives the creator share now. The creator can change it with 7 days' public notice (see pendingPayee).

holderBps.description: Current holder share; it can only go up.

pendingPayee.description: A creator share destination change the creator proposed: it takes effect when anyone applies it after effectiveAt (7 days after the proposal). Null when none is pending.

migrated.description: Set when the router adopted a token launched outside Claire (read from the router's Adopted event); null for tokens launched through Claire. Fees before the migration were never charged.

at.description: ISO time of the adoption block; null when it could not be read.

locked.description: Tokens the Claire lock contracts hold for locks of this token (vested but unclaimed included) and their share of total supply.

percent.description: Share of total supply with up to four decimals, or "<0.0001".

locks.description: The organization's published locks of this token.

openingLock.description: From the confirmed launch receipt; null when this app has none for the token.

url.description: The lock's proof page when it is published.

ponsLocked.description: pons only: launch tokens the launchpad's locker holds.

revenue.description: Router revenue and the holder rounds published from its distributor.

routed.description: Revenue the router has counted on chain.

published.description: Cumulative total promised to holders by the latest confirmed round.

feeRecipient.description: The launchpad's creator-fee recipient; ok is true when the Claire router is the recipient and no change is pending. Null when it could not be read.

links.description: Connections the organization made inside Claire: an X account linked by OAuth, a public Telegram chat the Claire bot administers, a custom domain Claire verified. Not on-chain facts.
